name: Banseiki Sengoku trees: first research and civic progress

steps.code: local limit=GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAME_TURN_LIMIT'); if limit~=DB.MakeHash('TURNLIMIT_NONE') then error('turn limit not NONE: '..tostring(limit)) end; return 'turn limit NONE after Create Game setup'

for _,victory in ipairs({'VICTORY_DEFAULT','VICTORY_CONQUEST','VICTORY_TECHNOLOGY','VICTORY_CULTURE','VICTORY_RELIGIOUS','VICTORY_DIPLOMATIC','VICTORY_SCORE'}) do if Game.IsVictoryEnabled(victory) then error('official victory enabled: '..victory) end end; local endTurn=Game.GetGameEndTurn(); if endTurn>0 then error('hard turn limit: game ends at turn '..tostring(endTurn)) end; return 'no official victory or time limit enabled'

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; local t,c=0,0; for row in GameInfo.Technologies() do t=t+1; if not string.find(row.TechnologyType,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech: '..row.TechnologyType) end end; for row in GameInfo.Civics() do c=c+1; if not string.find(row.CivicType,'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official civic: '..row.CivicType) end end; if t~=32 or c~=30 then error('wrong tree counts '..t..'/'..c) end; if GameInfo.Eras['ERA_ANCIENT'].Name~='LOC_JAC_ERA_TENBUN_NAME' then error('Sengoku era missing') end; if not GameClimate or not GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange or not Game.GetWorldCongress then error('GS core APIs missing') end; if GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange()==nil or not Game.GetWorldCongress() then error('GS systems inactive') end; return '32 techs, 30 civics, GS systems present'

local n=0; for id,_ in pairs(g_kItemDefaults) do n=n+1; if not string.find(id,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech in UI: '..id) end end; if n~=32 then error('tech UI count '..n) end; return 'TechTree shows only 32 Sengoku nodes'

local n=0; for id,_ in pairs(g_kItemDefaults) do n=n+1; if not string.find(id,'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official civic in UI: '..id) end end; if n~=30 then error('civic UI count '..n) end; return 'CivicsTree shows only 30 Sengoku nodes'

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; if p:GetCities():GetCount()~=0 then error('expected settler start') end; local s=nil; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units['UNIT_SETTLER'].Index then s=u; break end end; if not s then error('missing PoC settler') end; UnitManager.RequestOperation(s,UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY); return 'capital requested'

local id=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); local p=Players[id]; local techs,culture=p:GetTechs(),p:GetCulture(); for _,k in ipairs({'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRRIGATION_WORKS','TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_COASTAL_PILOTAGE','TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_IRON_FORGING','TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_EARTHWORK_FORTS'}) do if not techs:HasTech(GameInfo.Technologies[k].Index) then error('starting tech missing: '..k) end end; for _,k in ipairs({'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_HOUSE_RULES','CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_KOKUJIN_LEAGUES','CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TEMPLES_AND_BELIEVERS'}) do if not culture:HasCivic(GameInfo.Civics[k].Index) then error('starting civic missing: '..k) end end; local function pick(tbl,key,can) local best; for row in GameInfo[tbl]() do if can(row.Index) and (not best or row.Cost<best.Cost or (row.Cost==best.Cost and row.Index<best.Index)) then best=row end end; return best end; local t=pick('Technologies','TechnologyType',function(i) return not techs:HasTech(i) and techs:CanResearch(i) end); local c=pick('Civics','CivicType',function(i) return not culture:HasCivic(i) and culture:CanProgress(i) end); if not t or not c then error('no researchable Sengoku tech/civic after the starting knowledge: '..tostring(t and t.TechnologyType)..'/'..tostring(c and c.CivicType)) end; local tr=techs:GetResearchPath(GameInfo.Types[t.TechnologyType].Hash); local cr=culture:GetCivicPath(GameInfo.Types[c.CivicType].Hash); if not tr or not cr then error('next-node paths unavailable: '..t.TechnologyType..'/'..c.CivicType) end; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(id,PlayerOperations.RESEARCH,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_TECH_TYPE]=tr,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_INSERT_MODE]=PlayerOperations.VALUE_EXCLUSIVE}); UI.RequestPlayerOperation(id,PlayerOperations.PROGRESS_CIVIC,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CIVIC_TYPE]=cr,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_INSERT_MODE]=PlayerOperations.VALUE_EXCLUSIVE}); ExposedMembers.JAC_SengokuTreeProbe={tech=t.Index,civic=c.Index,science=techs:GetResearchProgress(t.Index),culture=culture:GetCulturalProgress(c.Index)}; return 'starting knowledge present; selected '..t.TechnologyType..' and '..c.CivicType

local s=ExposedMembers.JAC_SengokuTreeProbe; if not s then error('selection from the previous step is missing') end; local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; local techs,culture=p:GetTechs(),p:GetCulture(); local science,civic=techs:GetResearchProgress(s.tech),culture:GetCulturalProgress(s.civic); local t,c=GameInfo.Technologies[s.tech].TechnologyType,GameInfo.Civics[s.civic].CivicType; if not (techs:HasTech(s.tech) or science>s.science) or not (culture:HasCivic(s.civic) or civic>s.culture) then error('selected research did not progress '..t..' '..tostring(s.science)..'->'..tostring(science)..' / '..c..' '..tostring(s.culture)..'->'..tostring(civic)) end; return 'next research progressed '..t..' '..s.science..'->'..science..', '..c..' '..s.culture..'->'..civic
